sloka: नैव चक्रे मनः स्थातुम् वीक्षमाणो महाबलौ ।कपेः परम भीतस्य चित्तम् व्यवससाद ह ॥४-२-३॥
transliteration: naiva cakre manaḥ sthātum vīkṣamāṇo mahābalau ।kapeḥ parama bhītasya cittam vyavasasāda ha ॥4-2-3॥

translations.english: Beholding the two strong heroes, the monkey (Sugriva) was very much frightened. His heart sank.
